MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In MANDARIN CHINESE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Only memorise without using the language

2. When practising Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 2.4.1 Word Classes ● Preposition 在 ● Interrogative pronoun 哪儿.
